meta.title: The Last Divided Capital City in the World
meta._convention: One scene-spec JSON per script, saved alongside it as <script-name>.scenes.json. Each beat's `duration` is intentionally omitted -- build_video.js fills it in at render time from the ACTUAL measured length of that beat's generated narration WAV.
meta._note: Cyprus is a real polygon (highlight: ["CY"]). The Green Line / UN buffer zone and the Turkish-controlled north have no separate polygon in world-atlas, so the north/south split is drawn as a hand-authored `lines` entry running roughly east-west across the island through Nicosia.

beats.voText: This capital city has been cut in half since 1974, and the line running through it hasn't moved since.
It's Nicosia, Cyprus, split by a UN-patrolled buffer zone, the Republic of Cyprus to the south, Turkish-controlled territory to the north.
beats.onScreenText: Split, north and south, by the UN.

beats.voText: It's the only capital city on Earth still divided by a hard international border, every other divided capital eventually reunified.
beats.onScreenText: The last divided capital on Earth.

beats.voText: The buffer zone runs directly through the old city, so a checkpoint sits in the middle of what used to be an ordinary shopping street.
beats.onScreenText: A checkpoint. In the middle of the street.

beats.voText: Inside that buffer zone sits an entire abandoned airport, untouched since 1974, an old airliner is still parked on its runway.
One capital, one line, over 50 years unmoved, and a whole airport still waiting for flights that never came back. Follow for more places on Earth that shouldn't exist, but do.
